title: Chapter 7 First Battle
content:
Chapter 7 First Battle

In a large courtyard of the government office, fifty soldiers gathered together solemnly, and Zhong Yu stood on a makeshift high platform to give lectures.

"Soldiers, you must have heard it just now. The ten scouts reported that our surroundings are not safe and are full of countless barbarians. They are brutal, evil, fierce, full of barbaric thoughts, and have not yet accepted civilization!"

"Now our security is threatened. If we can't eliminate them in time, then if they attack us when we are not prepared, we will suffer a lot of losses. Will the house be robbed by them? Will the food be moved? It's time for us to become refugees again, to become homeless people!"

"You said, can we let them do this? Let them snatch us, kill us, or do we snatch them? Kill them? Tell me louder."

Zhong Yu's face was flushed, and he shouted excitedly on the high platform, full of hoarseness, and shouted out in one breath.

After the soldiers in the audience heard Zhong Yu's words, they remembered the white, tender and fragrant rice they had just eaten. Eat bran and swallow vegetables, and live a life that is worse than death under the hands of the landlord.

Later, I joined the Yellow Turban Army, and I didn’t eat a single meal. People often starved to death and couldn’t keep up. Even when I changed my son to eat, I finally had such a good life now. Control, such a good lord, no one can drive him away and take away his happy life. Involuntarily shouted in unison:

"No one can take away our good days and drive away the lord. Whoever dares to do so will kill me. If he wants my life, I will kill him. Long live the lord, drive away the barbarians, the lord. Long live, destroy the savages."

After a while of encouragement from Zhong Yu, the morale of the entire army rose to the point of frenzy. At this time, Zhong Yu asked them to do whatever they dared to do, and even if they were to die, they would not frown.

After that, the whole army was disbanded and asked them to go back and prepare some necessary items, neatly equip them, and bring enough ordnance.

Although I believed that after my own training, the soldiers would not escape from the battle, I still called Wang Daniu and told him to prepare the soldiers' minds, don't show up, and wait for the idea of fighting. I don't want to encounter this situation in the first battle.

After resting for a while, Zhong Yu estimated that the soldiers were ready for battle, so they called the entire army, assembled and prepared to set off.

The whole army was neatly equipped and majestic, striding out of the government office with high spirits, and hurried towards the tribe that Ergouzi was investigating. The tribe of only 20 people, with their own strength of 50 people, can be destroyed by hand.

All the way to the tribe, I encountered a few beasts in the middle, but seeing so many people, those beasts were smart and avoided far away, and there was no risk along the way, just settled with their tribe.

When they were about to approach the tribe, Zhong Yu ordered the entire army to disperse. There were five people as a team, split up and slowly surrounded them, slowly and silently lurking in the past.

Those people were still revelling, they had something to eat, and when they got excited, they did it on the spot with two men and women hugging each other, and they didn't feel embarrassed.

It's really a bunch of uncivilized savages, but it's okay, so that it's convenient for me to capture them slowly and make them my slaves.

In this way, because the surrounding grass is very lush, reaching the height of half a waist, the whole army crouches on the ground, using the grass to cover, no one can find it, so they come to the front in peace.

Slowly crawling forward, when it was a hundred paces, finally a savage seemed to have urinated because he drank too much water. He saw the surrounding grass swinging abnormally, and heard some unusual noises. aroused his suspicions.

Looking at it, he noticed that Zhong Yu and his party were slowly lurking up. Realizing the danger, he immediately screamed loudly about what he found, as if it was their dialect, but he couldn't understand it, like Howling like a beast.

Oops, damn it! Being discovered by the savage, Wang Daniu seemed very angry, he rushed up immediately, shouted, and was extremely brave. Under the sunlight, his jet-black armor shone like a man from heaven, scaring the savage. stunned.

Wang Daniu seized the opportunity and stepped forward quickly. Before the savage could react, he chopped off the savage's head with one sword and held it in his hand, full of suffocation!

Seeing the bloody scene, the other savages were stunned for a while, and then they all screamed madly. The men could also hold a stone spear and rushed up.

The female savages also picked up the stones and threw them at the Yellow Turbans. The children hid in the middle, shivering, and the scene suddenly became intense.

After Wang Daniu killed a person, his expression became more intense. The savage who took the lead rushed forward. After a while, he fought with the man who seemed to be the leader of the savage. For a while, you came and I came, and the scene was so thrilling. .

And the soldiers at the back, who were a little stunned because they were discovered, saw the scene where the fight had already started, and they rushed up quickly and fought with the savages.

Ergouzi looked at the vicious savages in front of him, and couldn't help but feel a little scared, but when he remembered the kindness that the lord had just shown him, he couldn't help but firm up his beliefs, and recalled the scenes of those savages eating meat before, and he couldn't help but feel more and more in his heart. envy.

Two emotions controlled his mood, he couldn't help shouting, rushed up, and fought with the savage. For a while, with Ergouzi's bravery and fearless spirit, he pressed the savage for a while.

After all, Ergouzi's body is still a little bad. After all, when he was in the Yellow Turban Army, he couldn't eat enough for a long time, but after allegiance to Zhong Yu, what is the use of having a full meal just now? The body still hasn't recovered, what can compare to these savages who eat meat every day.

Slowly, he fell down immediately. The savage saw Ergouzi's weakness and immediately slaughtered him. Suddenly, Ergouzi's condition was very bad. There were dangers and dangers. A few mouthfuls of blood.

Slowly, the passing of vitality was reflected in his body, and his strength became weaker and weaker. He almost avoided fatal stab wounds several times. Finally, Ergouzi couldn't hold on anymore and was slashed by the savage. The body was dripping with blood, and a small hole was smashed out of the mind.

Slowly, he fell to the ground, his eyes slowly blurring. I can't help but think, are you going to die? Are you going to die? But it’s okay, before I died, I ate a meal of meat, a full meal, and was praised by the lord. I don’t have any regrets. Moreover, this time I have repaid the lord’s knowledge. Well! Thinking about these things, his consciousness slowly blurred, and his eyes slowly closed.

Ergouzi lost his young life like this, but at the age of 18, he has experienced several years of wars and a life of displacement. It is also a blessing for him to die earlier!

To encounter troubled times, for some people it is great luck, for some people it is unfortunate, who can tell clearly?

The strong are like a fish in water when the dragons and snakes land, and they can do great things; the weak are not as good as pigs and dogs in times of chaos.

I'd rather be a dog of peace than a person in troubled times, probably this is the kind of person I'm talking about!

It's not easy for a new book to hit the road, and I can only ask readers for your great support, collection, and recommendation. The author is here to spread flowers and thank you!
